name: Step-sequencer beat maker
summary: Toggle cells on a looping grid of drum sounds and steps to compose a beat that plays back continuously.
core_loop: pick a kit → tap cells on the grid → hear the loop → adjust tempo → save or share
rules: one loop of 8 or 16 steps
each row is one sound
win: no win state: the loop is the result
scoring: no score; friends can remix or react
example_prompts: a beat maker with a lofi kit
make a drum machine I can share with friends
sequencer where each row is a different animal sound

name: Piano-roll melody composer
summary: Place notes on a pitch-by-time grid in a chosen scale to compose a short melody and play it back.
core_loop: pick scale → tap notes on the grid → play back → tweak → save
rules: notes snap to the chosen scale
melody is short, a few bars
win: no win state: the melody is the result
scoring: no score; friends react to the melody
social_hooks: send a melody for a friend to continue
birthday jingle for a Group member
example_prompts: a melody maker in a spooky scale
song maker where I can send the tune to a friend

name: Loop station layering
summary: Record or choose short loops and layer them one after another into a growing arrangement over a shared tempo.
core_loop: start a loop → add a new layer on top → mute or solo layers → build a full track
rules: all layers share a length
layers snap to the beat
win: no win state: the track is the result
social_hooks: friends add a layer to your loop
example_prompts: a loop station with my voice

name: Melody echo
summary: A short melody plays on colored keys and the player repeats it by tapping the same keys, with the melody growing each round.
core_loop: hear melody → tap it back → melody extends by one note → repeat until a miss
rules: melody grows by one note
mistake ends the run

name: Sing the pitch
summary: The player sings into the mic and a pitch tracker scores how close each held note is to a target.
core_loop: hear note → sing it → meter shows pitch → hold within tolerance → next
rules: tolerance in cents
must hold for a second
social_hooks: friends compete on the same melody
example_prompts: a game where I sing the note shown

name: Hum to notes
summary: The player hums a tune and sees it transcribed into notes, then plays it back in a chosen instrument.
core_loop: hum → app transcribes → pick instrument → play and share
rules: short hummed phrase
win: no win state: the transcription is the result
social_hooks: send a hummed melody to a friend
example_prompts: hum a tune and turn it into a piano melody

name: Rhythm echo
summary: A rhythm of taps plays and the player taps it back with matching timing.
core_loop: hear rhythm → tap it back → timing scored → pattern grows harder
rules: timing tolerance in ms
patterns grow

name: Interval ear trainer
summary: Two notes play and the player identifies the interval between them.
core_loop: hear two notes → pick interval → feedback → next
rules: choices limited to taught intervals

name: Name that note
summary: A single note plays and the player names it, optionally with a reference tone.
core_loop: hear a note → pick its name → feedback
rules: one chance per note

name: Chord builder
summary: The player builds a named chord from a keyboard or fretboard, or hears a chord and names it.
core_loop: see chord name → tap notes → check → next
rules: notes must match the chord

name: Beat battle
summary: Two players each make a beat from the same samples, and friends vote on the better one.
core_loop: get sample pack → build beat → submit → votes
rules: same samples for both
example_prompts: make a beat from the same samples

name: Song stem pass
summary: Each friend adds one stem, such as drums, bass or melody, to a growing track.
core_loop: get track → add a stem → pass on
rules: one stem each
scoring: no score; friends react to or vote on the result
example_prompts: build a song with friends one stem at a time

name: DJ mashup
summary: Two loops play on decks and the player crossfades, filters and times them to make a smooth mashup.
core_loop: load decks → move crossfader → apply filters → build the mix
rules: keep loops in sync
win: no win state: the mix is the result

name: Beat match sync
summary: Two beats play at different tempos and the player adjusts pitch until their beats align.
core_loop: hear mismatch → drag tempo → align → score
rules: two loops run at different tempos
dragging a tempo slider speeds one deck up or down
score rises with the time the beats stay aligned within tolerance
example_prompts: a dj game where I match the beats of two songs
line up two tempos by ear

name: Text to song
summary: The player describes a song and the server composes it, with lyrics and style, for sharing.
rules: short clips
win: no win state: the song is the result
social_hooks: make a song about a friend
example_prompts: make a song about my friend's birthday
a rap about our road trip

name: Rhyme builder
summary: The player completes verses by choosing or typing rhyming lines to a beat.
core_loop: read couplet start → choose a rhyme → beat plays → verse scored
rules: last words must rhyme

name: Karaoke follow
summary: Lyrics scroll in time and the player taps or sings along, scored on timing.
core_loop: lyrics scroll → sing or tap on beat → scored
rules: timing windows

name: Instrument by ear
summary: A short sound plays and the player names the instrument.
rules: one short sample plays per question
four instrument choices, one correct
samples replay on request
example_prompts: orchestra sound quiz with harry potter theme music instruments

name: Tap-rhythm tune guess
summary: A song's rhythm plays without pitch and the player names the song.
rules: only the rhythm of a well-known tune plays, no pitch
guess by typing the title
a hint reveals the first word of the title
example_prompts: guess the song from the rhythm taps
name that tune from only the beat
tap rhythm guessing for disney songs

name: Sound pad
summary: Tap pads to trigger sounds and perform a live jam, optionally recorded.
rules: each pad triggers one sample
pads can be one-shot or looped
a recording captures the performance
example_prompts: a soundboard of my friends' catchphrases

name: Touch theremin
summary: Slide a finger to change pitch and volume continuously.
rules: horizontal position sets pitch continuously
vertical position sets volume
an optional scale snap makes it easier
example_prompts: slide synth I can play with one finger

name: Marble music composer
summary: Drop marbles onto pegs that play notes, arranging pegs to form a melody.
rules: pegs placed on a board each play a note when a marble hits
marbles fall by gravity from a dropper
peg position sets pitch and timing
example_prompts: music box where balls hit pegs
drop marbles to make a tune

name: Character band
summary: Drag sounds onto characters in a band, each adding a layer, to build a song.
core_loop: drag sound to character → layer → unlock bonus
rules: each character slot accepts one sound at a time
sounds belong to beat, effect, melody or voice groups
right combinations unlock a bonus layer
example_prompts: make a beat with cartoon characters

name: Tap to sound and animate
summary: Each tap or key triggers a sound with a matching animation.
rules: every key or tap maps to a distinct sound and animation
sounds are drawn from one coherent palette
no scoring or failure
win: no win state: a play session
example_prompts: sound and animation toy for kids

name: Rhythm reading
summary: A rhythm plays and the player picks matching notation.
rules: a rhythm plays once or twice
pick the matching notation from four choices
choices differ by one note value or rest

name: Drum pattern replicate
summary: A drum pattern plays and the player reproduces it on the step grid.
rules: a one-bar drum pattern plays
the player toggles cells to reproduce it
feedback marks matching and missing cells
example_prompts: copy the drum pattern by ear
replicate this beat on the grid

name: Beatbox loop
summary: Record vocal percussion sounds that are classified and layered into a beat.
rules: mic input is classified into kick, snare or hat sounds
classified hits snap to the grid
the recorded bar loops
example_prompts: turn my mouth sounds into drums
voice drum loop for the group chat

name: Foley scene
summary: Record sounds for events in a short silent scene.
rules: a short silent clip shows events with timestamps
the player records a sound for each event
recordings are synced to the clip
example_prompts: make the sounds for a cartoon scene
voice the sound effects of a silent clip

name: Playlist curator
summary: Players pick tracks for a themed playlist and friends vote.
rules: a theme and a slot count are given
each player picks tracks that fit
friends vote on the best playlist
example_prompts: curate a road trip playlist and vote

name: Lyric swap
summary: A song template has blanks for the player to fill with rhymes and syllables.
rules: each blank has a required syllable count or rhyme
filled lyrics play back over the track
no failure state
example_prompts: fill in blanks to make a funny song

name: Mixing levels target
summary: Adjust volumes of tracks to match a reference mix.
rules: a reference mix plays
the player sets track faders to match it
score depends on the distance of each fader from the reference
example_prompts: balance the instruments to match the song

name: Harmonize a melody
summary: A melody plays and the player adds a harmony line that fits.
rules: a melody plays in a key
added notes are checked against consonant intervals
notes may only land on the key's scale
example_prompts: add a harmony to this tune
write the second voice for this melody

name: Tap the tempo
summary: Hear a song and tap its tempo to match its BPM.
rules: a clip plays without a click
the player taps along
score depends on the difference between tapped and true BPM
example_prompts: tap the tempo of the song
tap tempo challenge with my friends

name: Tune the string
summary: Turn a peg to tune a string to a reference pitch.
rules: a reference tone plays
the player drags a peg to change string pitch
success when within a few cents for a second
example_prompts: match the pitch by turning the peg

name: Strum and chord change
summary: Tap strumming patterns while changing chords on time.
rules: chord changes arrive on the beat
strums follow a shown pattern
a missed change breaks the combo
example_prompts: practice chord changes with a beat

name: Live jam session
summary: Friends share a live room where each controls one instrument pad, in sync to the same tempo.
core_loop: join room → play pads → hear mix
rules: each friend controls one instrument pad
everyone shares a tempo clock
the room records the jam
example_prompts: live music jam with my group

name: Draw a melody
summary: Draw a curve and the app turns it into a melody.
rules: the y position of the stroke maps to pitch
the x position maps to time
pitches snap to a chosen scale
example_prompts: sketch a tune and hear it

name: Field recording track
summary: Record sounds from daily life and arrange into a track.
rules: record short sounds from the environment
sounds are placed on a timeline
each sound may be pitched or looped
example_prompts: record sounds around me into a song
turn my day into a track
